release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.1.1

• **Animated Live Lyrics Instagram Story Video**: Story Studio now encodes 15fps MP4 videos using Android GPU EGL Surface compositing with smoothly scrolling karaoke lyrics, reactive equalizer bars, and a live moving playback bar.
• **Automatic Paused-Position Story Audio**: Added Rust sample-accurate fallback seeking + Android native MediaExtractor/MediaCodec fallback and automatic stereo PCM normalization so Instagram Stories receives an actual MP4 video playing the song right from where you paused.
• **Interactive Live Preview**: Preview live continuing lyrics and beat motion right inside Story Studio before exporting or sharing.
